declarations.explanation: site/ is a Site that meets every typescript-astro rule: Astro 7, React 19, Tailwind 4, TypeScript 6 checked by astro check, node --test, oxlint 1 and Prettier 3 with the Astro plugin, pnpm 11 on Node 24 or 26, a validate that really runs astro check and ui:check, CI on both majors, and the six shadcn rules.
evidence: site/package.json pins astro 7.4.4 with @astrojs/starlight 0.42.8 and @astrojs/react 7.1.2 (framework major 7), react and react-dom 19.3.0, tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/vite 4.3.3, typescript 6.0.3 with @astrojs/check 0.9.12, and the exact shadcn 4.22.1 devDependency.

site/astro.config.mjs builds a static site (no adapter) from ../docs/usage and ../docs/adr through Starlight and from build-time catalogue data in src/lib/load-catalogue.ts, with React islands only (SiteNav, Home and SourceAdoption with client:load, the docs SupportMenu with client:settled): a Site, not an App.

site/package.json validate runs `pnpm ui:check && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build:fixture`; `check` is `astro check` (0 errors, 0 warnings over 123 files on the migration head) and `ui:check` runs scripts/registry.mjs check against registry-manifest.json (passes).

Root package.json validate ends with `pnpm --dir site validate`; .github/workflows/validate.yml's site job runs `pnpm --dir site validate` on the Node 24/26 matrix, and the three required aggregates need both site shards to succeed.

Root package.json holds packageManager pnpm@11.20.0, pnpm-lock.yaml, engines node >=24 <25 || >=26 <27, oxlint 1.86.0, Prettier 3.9.9 and prettier-plugin-astro 1.1.1; root lint and format:check cover site.
Tests use `node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.ts` with no other runner; no ESLint or Vitest is installed.

site/components.json sets style base-nova and iconLibrary lucide; ui:add and ui:update run the pinned CLI through scripts/registry.mjs, which records every generated file of src/components/ui/ in registry-manifest.json; Prettier and oxlint ignore that folder.

src/components/app/ holds ten one-line re-exports (badge, button, card, dialog, dropdown-menu, empty, input-group, kbd, toggle-group, tooltip); no wrapper exists. Custom components such as site-nav.tsx and the sign art live outside components/app/.

Shared effects use data-slot rules in stylesheets: global.css gives every Dropdown Menu item the Button's focus ring, docs-components.css fills preflight gaps by data-slot, and sign/light.css lights components by data-slot; generated files are unchanged.
src/styles/shadcn-theme.css holds the colour tokens in :root and .dark; src/lib/theme-core.ts toggles the .dark class together with Starlight's data-theme attribute.
